    static int readInt(DataInputStream in) throws IOException {

        while (c <= ' ') c = in.read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;

    static int solveSmall(int n, int m) {
        int states = 1 << (3 * n);
        int[] dp = new int[(m + 1) * (n + 1) * states];
        for (int col = 0; col <= n; col++) {

                for (int mask = 0; mask < states; mask++) {
                    if ((mask & 1) == 1) {
                        dp[idx(m, n, states, row, col, mask)] = dp[idx(m, n, states, row, col + 1, mask >> 1)];
                        continue;
                    }
                    int val = dp[idx(m, n, states, row, col + 1, mask >> 1)];
                    val = Math.max(val, dp[idx(m, n, states, row, col + 1, (mask >> 1) + (1 << (3 * n - 1)))] + 2);
